name: Magicious

features.name: Expanding wild respin
features.description: Wilds expand and trigger a respin.

review:
A stage-magic show on 10 lines, where wins pay both ways and an expanding wild triggers a respin.

Simple and easy to pick up. Both-ways wins help hits line up from either side, and the expanding wild respin is the main moment to wait for. Low volatility, 1,400x cap, 96.0% RTP. A tidy game for relaxed play, and nice if you're tired of busy modern features.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
